prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a modern laptop screen, specifically an ASUS VivoBook OLED, dominates the composition. The display features a vibrant, abstract wallpaper with bold, dynamic brushstrokes in electric blue, magenta, teal, and white, intersected by diagonal black and white stripes, creating a sense of energy and movement. The right side of the screen subtly displays the ASUS VivoBook OLED branding in sleek, white text. In the foreground, a semi-transparent notification icon appears at the center, showing a stylized plug and lightning bolt symbol with the words "Plugged In," indicating the device is charging. The Windows 11 taskbar is visible along the bottom edge, with familiar icons such as Microsoft Edge, File Explorer, and the Start menu, rendered in soft, modern hues. The lighting is natural and even, with a slight reflection on the glossy screen surface, suggesting an indoor setting. The overall style is crisp and contemporary, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the screen’s vivid details while softly blurring the edges, evoking a sense of immediacy and technological sophistication.
